title: Oceans
page_title: Oceans | Cambridge (CIE) IGCSE Environmental Management Revision Notes 2025

blocks.md:
- Oceans are **very large **expanses of sea (**saltwater**)

  - They represent the main areas into which the sea is divided geographically
- There are **five** recognised oceans:

  - Pacific Ocean
  - Atlantic Ocean
  - Indian Ocean
  - Arctic Ocean
  - Southern Ocean

blocks.alt: A map of the world showing the seven recognised continents and five recognised oceans
blocks.caption: A map of the world showing the seven recognised continents and five recognised oceans

blocks.md:
- There are also many recognised **seas** on the planet, such as:

  - Mediterranean Sea
  - Black Sea
  - Irish Sea
  - Dead Sea
  - Caribbean Sea
- Seas are **smaller** areas of water than oceans and they are often **partially enclosed by land**
